segments.an6.82:1.1: “Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an6.82:1.2: Katamehi chahi [musāvādī hoti, pisuṇavācā hoti, pharusavāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti,(sī. syā. pī.) evaṃ sukkapakkhepi]?
segments.an6.82:1.3: Pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādī hoti [musāvādī hoti, pisuṇavācā hoti, pharusavāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti,(sī. syā. pī.) evaṃ sukkapakkhepi], luddho ca, pagabbho ca.
segments.an6.82:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an6.82:2.1: “Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an6.82:2.3: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, aluddho ca, appagabbho ca.
segments.an6.82:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.

lines: Dasame vighātavāti mahicchataṃ nissāya uppannena lobhadukkhena dukkhito.
